name: Cucumber

basicInfo.description: Cucumbers are fast-growing vines that produce refreshing fruits perfect for salads and pickling. They need warmth, sun, and plenty of space to spread.
whyGrow: Fresh, crunchy cucumbers right from the garden
Perfect for salads, sandwiches, and pickles
High yields from a few plants
basicInfo.spacing: 60–90cm between plants (or train vertically on trellis)
basicInfo.water: Frequent deep watering, keep soil moist but not waterlogged

growingSteps: Plant seeds 1–2cm deep directly outdoors after frost risk passes
Provide a trellis or support for vines to climb
Water regularly to keep soil consistently moist
Mulch around plants to retain moisture
Harvest cucumbers when firm and bright green

careCalendar.description: Plant in warm soil with plenty of sun.
Add trellis or stakes to guide vine growth.
Pick cucumbers when firm and 15–20cm long.

symptoms: Lots of flowers but few fruits

harvestingGuide: Harvest cucumbers when they reach 15–20cm long and are firm to the touch. Pick frequently to encourage more fruiting. Do not let fruits over-ripen on the vine.
estimatedSavings: Growing cucumbers at home can save $50–80 per season, especially if you eat salads or make pickles regularly.
